scope: B2-G deterministic same-version v0 candidate/fallback computation kernel

hard_bounds.validator_id_bytes: 1..128 inclusive; opaque nonempty bytes, including all-zero byte sequences
hard_bounds.preclone_rule: Exceeding either cardinality bound, or supplying an empty or over-128-byte task_id/consumer_id, returns atomic fallback reason 1 with empty diagnostics before cloning, sorting, or indexing transcript entries.

same_version_context.target_epoch_rule: target_epoch = old active validator-set epoch + 1 using checked u64 arithmetic; snapshot_epoch must equal the old active epoch for reason 0, while mismatch yields atomic fallback reason 1

validator_key_proof_of_possession_v0.signature_scheme: strict RFC 8032 Ed25519 over the 32-byte digest

signing_preimage_field_order.name: chain_id
signing_preimage_field_order.rule: 1..128 bytes; first byte [a-z0-9], every remaining byte [a-z0-9._:-]

signing_preimage_field_order.name: public_key
signing_preimage_field_order.rule: the exact decoder rejects only the all-zero 32-byte value; invalid strict Ed25519 point/small-order encodings fail production StrictEd25519Verifier and yield reason 4

validator_key_proof_of_possession_v0.exact_object_rule: The exact bounded object CEV0 is the seven-field signing preimage followed by fixed Signature64. The signature is not part of the signing preimage digest.
validator_key_proof_of_possession_v0.candidate_rule: A new or changed key requires a finalized, exact-scope, strict-Ed25519-valid proof and a registration_nonce strictly greater than the caller-supplied previous nonce. Missing, invalid, stale-nonce, wrong-scope, or wrong-key proof invalidates the complete candidate with fallback reason 4; it is never silently dropped into reason 3.
validator_key_proof_of_possession_v0.unchanged_key_rule: A byte-identical old validator identity/key may omit a new proof; this bounded kernel does not authenticate the old registration state.

kernel_inputs.name: old_validator_set
kernel_inputs.rule: caller-supplied active set; must validate or the caller must halt rather than mint fallback evidence

kernel_inputs.name: old_parameters
kernel_inputs.rule: caller-supplied active parameter preimage; must validate or the caller must halt

kernel_inputs.name: candidate_parameters
kernel_inputs.rule: caller-supplied candidate parameter preimage; validated by the B2-G bounded relation kernel

unauthenticated_candidate_selection_tran.candidate_parameter_preimage_validation: The complete caller-supplied ConsensusParametersV0 preimage first passes validate_safety_invariants. This list is not an exhaustive acceptance-input list; a successful effective or computed set binds the hash of the complete validated parameter preimage.

old_validator_entry.name: validator_id
old_validator_entry.rule: opaque nonempty 1..128 bytes; all-zero byte sequences are valid identities

candidate_entry.name: validator_id
candidate_entry.rule: opaque nonempty 1..candidate max_validator_id_bytes; all-zero byte sequences are valid identities

candidate_entry.name: active_slashable_bond
candidate_entry.rule: caller-supplied amount asserted slashable through the target epoch/evidence window

contribution_entry.name: provider_validator_id
contribution_entry.rule: must identify a supplied candidate when eligible; opaque all-zero nonempty IDs are valid

contribution_entry.name: finalized_epoch
contribution_entry.rule: eligible facts with finalized_epoch > snapshot_epoch are reason 1

contribution_entry.name: eligible
contribution_entry.rule: caller-supplied result of certificate, finalized-state, meter, relationship, challenge, revocation, identity mapping, and cutoff checks

unauthenticated_candidate_selection_tran.input_order: Candidate and contribution input permutations are accepted. The kernel sorts candidates by raw validator_id and contributions by raw certificate_id before deterministic computation. Duplicate candidate IDs, duplicate candidate keys, and duplicate certificate IDs fail closed.
unauthenticated_candidate_selection_tran.explicit_non_freeze: The transcript does not freeze, decode, authenticate, or replace ConsumptionCertificateV0 transport/application state. It consumes only bounded caller-supplied contribution facts.

forbidden: decimal-string arithmetic without exact BigInt parsing
checked_arithmetic.overflow_behavior: Record fallback reason 2 and do not salvage a partial candidate.

candidate_algorithm.maturity: snapshot_epoch >= finalized_epoch + maturity_epochs using checked u128
relationship_caps: x(provider, task, consumer) = checked sum of per-certificate units
y(provider, task) = checked sum over consumer_id in ascending raw-byte order
z(provider) = checked sum over task_id in ascending raw-byte order
candidate_algorithm.candidate_eligibility: raw_power >= min_validator_power, registration_valid, not jailed, exact identity mapping, and the PoP rule passes
candidate_algorithm.selection: If eligible count exceeds max_validators, select exactly max_validators by descending raw_power then ascending raw validator_id bytes; encode the selected candidate in ascending raw validator_id order.

rollout_weights.shadow: Compute candidate diagnostics, set computed_candidate_validator_set=None, and atomically carry old membership/keys/weights to target_epoch while binding validated candidate parameters. fallback_used remains false and fallback_reason is 0.
rollout_weights.full: effective_weight = 1 + floor(full_weight_alpha_ppm * (raw_power - 1) / scale_ppm); same-version v0 requires full_weight_alpha_ppm = scale_ppm

set_validity: validator IDs and public keys are unique, weights are positive, and every weight fits u64

fallback_reasons.name: none
fallback_reasons.rule: candidate succeeds; shadow carry is not fallback

fallback_reasons.name: malformed_snapshot_input
fallback_reasons.example: snapshot height/cutoff or epoch mismatch, preclone cardinality excess, duplicate certificate ID, invalid task/consumer length, eligible future-finalized fact, or eligible zero-unit/unknown-provider relation

fallback_reasons.name: arithmetic_failure
fallback_reasons.example: unexpected checked u128 add/multiply/conversion failure; normative max(0, scale-age*step) decay-to-zero is not a failure

fallback_reasons.name: too_few_eligible_validators
fallback_reasons.example: fewer than min_validators after valid eligibility evaluation, including a shadow old count below the candidate minimum

fallback_reasons.name: invalid_validator_identity_or_key
fallback_reasons.example: invalid identity/key uniqueness, registration, nonce, missing required PoP, PoP scope, or PoP signature

fallback_reasons.name: validator_weight_out_of_bounds
fallback_reasons.example: selected rollout weight lies outside candidate min_validator_power..max_validator_power; eligibility-only with min_validator_power > 1 and shadow carry incompatible with candidate bounds are explicit cases

fallback_reasons.name: invalid_total_voting_power
fallback_reasons.example: effective W is zero or exceeds candidate max_total_voting_power, including an incompatible shadow carry

fallback_reasons.name: concentration_constraint_violated
fallback_reasons.example: 3*M >= W or the ppm share inequality fails

fallback_reasons.name: invalid_committed_parameters
fallback_reasons.example: candidate epoch_length_blocks changes, shadow old count exceeds candidate maximum, an old ID exceeds candidate max_validator_id_bytes, or another old/candidate tuple relation is inconsistent

fallback_reasons.name: invalid_upgrade_or_activation
fallback_reasons.example: production_activation is false while candidate rollout leaves shadow

lowest_reason_rule: Evaluate every deterministically applicable failure class without using iteration order as priority; when multiple reasons apply, commit the numerically lowest code in 1..9.

fallback_output.validator_set: old ordered validator ID/public-key/effective-weight tuples re-encoded only for target_epoch
fallback_output.consensus_parameters: old active parameters unchanged; candidate parameters are discarded
fallback_output.candidate_diagnostics: cleared to an empty list because malformed or rejected unauthenticated computations are non-authoritative
fallback_output.precondition: The caller-supplied old active set and parameters must themselves validate; otherwise this kernel fails closed instead of inventing a fallback.

candidate_selection_kernel_v0.success_output: private-field inert computation evidence containing deterministic diagnostics, computed candidate, active next-set selection, fallback flag, and lowest fallback reason

required_vector_coverage: deterministic real Ed25519 PoP fixtures with exact CEV0, digest, public key, and signature
valid shadow, eligibility-only, capped-weight, and full profiles
registration and contribution input permutations with byte-identical result
maturity, expiry, decay, per-certificate, consumer-provider, task-provider, provider, bond, raw-power, sorting, truncation, u64, and u128 boundaries
every fallback reason 1..9 and multi-fault lowest-reason selection
atomic fallback carry and explicit shadow-non-fallback carry
wrong PoP domain, chain, genesis, target epoch, validator ID, public key, nonce, stale nonce, missing proof, and invalid signature
raw invalid ChainId first-byte and tail-byte exact-decoder cases with stable invalid_chain_id code and length-prefix byte offset
honest_boundary: Only ValidatorKeyProofOfPossessionV0 has an exact canonical CEV0 preimage, frozen digest domain, and strict Ed25519 verification in B2-G.

UnauthenticatedCandidateSelectionTranscriptV0, contribution eligibility, finalized cutoff, validator registration state, active slashable bond, jail state, old active set, old parameters, and candidate parameters are caller-supplied and unauthenticated.

The kernel proves deterministic computation over its supplied transcript, not JMT/ICS23 membership, snapshot-state provenance, runtime execution, receipt provenance, checkpoint-body execution, governance provenance, anchor/handoff authority, activation, transition, or B2 completion.
A successful value is inert computation evidence only.
